title: NJ-Atlas layer recipe, v2 (NJ Atlas Studio)
description: One hand-written recipe per layer, stored as catalog/layers/<id>.json. Copy layers are built into map tiles, downloads and catalog entries; live layers are only described; hybrid layers build map tiles only (DECISIONS.md D-030). Field reference: docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md §4.1. Changing this schema requires a DECISIONS.md entry approved by the human owner.

id.description: Permanent layer ID. Must equal the file name without .json.

title.description: Plain-language name shown on the layer card, e.g. 'Preserved open space'.

category.description: Group heading in the viewer's Data list. Boundary layers (DECISIONS.md D-020) use boundaries and appear in the Boundary list instead.

status.description: draft layers appear only in local builds run with --include-drafts. published requires a human license review (see allOf below).

noun.description: Words for one item and many items, used in sentences like '12 of 564 municipalities match'.

summary.description: One or two plain-language sentences for a non-GIS reader. No jargon.

type.description: Only ArcGIS REST layers are supported in v1.

url.description: ArcGIS layer URL ending in /MapServer/<n> or /FeatureServer/<n>.

where.description: ArcGIS where clause. Use 1=1 for the whole layer.

id_field.description: Source field whose value becomes atlas_id. Must be unique. OBJECTID is acceptable.

landing_page.description: Human-readable page about the data, shown as 'More about this data'.

expected_count.description: The build stops if the source returns a count outside this range.

name.description: License or terms name as the publisher states it. null until known.

url.description: Where the terms are published. null until known.

attribution.description: Credit line shown on the map and in downloads.

reviewed_by.description: Human owner's name. Agents never fill this in.

reviewed_on.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the human review. Agents never fill this in.

fields.description: Source fields to keep, in display order. Everything else is dropped.

source.description: Exact field name in the ArcGIS layer (case-sensitive).

name.description: Output column name. Must not be a reserved name: atlas_id, lon, lat, geometry, or a place-tag column this layer receives.

filter.description: search for text, checklist for category, range for number or date, or none.

popup.description: Show in the click popup and the results table.

unit.description: Shown after numbers, e.g. 'acres' or 'sq mi'.

decimals.description: Decimals shown in the viewer and written to CSV. Data keeps full precision so filters match the source (D-018). Default 2.

transform.description: Optional clean-up. last3 keeps the last 3 characters; zfill3/zfill4 left-pad with zeros; titlecase turns 'CAPE MAY' into 'Cape May' (all applied before type conversion). sq_m_to_sq_mi turns square meters into square miles and zero_is_blank blanks zeros (number fields only, D-022, D-028). yymmdd reads dates like '941008' as 1994-10-08, with years 00-29 in the 2000s (date fields only, D-028).

lookup.description: A table join (D-085, D-086): the value comes from a column of catalog/lookups/<table>.json, keyed by this field's source value. Copy layers join at build time, and any field type but date may use it. Live and hybrid layers join in the browser: Studio's catalog turns the column into value_labels, so there it is for text and category fields only. Not with value_labels or transform.

value_labels.description: Text and category fields only (DECISIONS.md D-017). Replaces coded source values with plain words after any transform, e.g. {"Y": "Yes", "N": "No"}. Mapping a value to null makes it blank. Values not listed are kept as they are.

label_field.description: Output field name used as each item's title in popups and the table.

access.description: live: queried from the source at view time and never stored. hybrid: drawn from our map tiles; counts, lists and exports queried live. copy: built by the pipeline. The boundary layers must be copy (D-030).

area_mode.description: How the layer is sliced to the chosen area. tags: place columns built into a copy (D-006). code: the source's own code field, per area_codes; levels area_codes does not name use intersects. intersects: the server tests the area's outline (D-032).

area_codes.description: area_mode code only. The source field holding each level's code, and how to read it. mun_code: the 4-digit NJ municipal code ('1709'). mun_prefix: a 4-digit municipal code whose first 2 digits are the NJ county number ('17' is Salem). county_number: the 2-digit NJ county number. county_fips: the 3-digit county FIPS code ('033'). county_name: the county name, compared upper-case, with or without ' COUNTY'.

min_zoom.description: Live layers only: the zoom at which features start loading when the area holds more than 2,000 (fewer load whole, at any zoom). Set by density (D-081).

live_min_zoom.description: Hybrid layers only: the zoom at which features start loading while the map copy is not hosted (D-052, D-081). Default: tiles.min_zoom + 3.

styles.description: Style presets keyed by a short ID, 1 to 8 (IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md §4.3, D-086). Style fields are output field names.

default_style.description: The key in styles used when the layer is added.

buffer_role.description: source: can be buffered (buffer layers) and be a screening's site. target: listed inside screenings. both, or none. Boundary layers are target or none (D-074).

distance_query.description: Live and hybrid layers only: true when the service reports supportsQueryWithDistance, so buffer targets come from a distance query rather than sending the ring (D-033).

clip_mode.description: What data exports do at the area's edge. cut: lines and polygons are cut at the edge. mask: whole features are kept. Points are always mask.

list_fields.description: Buffer targets only: 1 to 4 output field names shown after the label field in buffer result lists. The first fills the combined list's Type column.

refresh_cadence.description: Shown in 'About this data'. live layers use live; copy and hybrid layers use one of the others.

leave_out.description: Source fields that must never be requested, shown or exported, usually personal data (CATALOG.md 'Leave out'). Required, even when empty.

coverage.description: Set only when the layer does not cover the whole state (D-085). Studio marks the layer 'Partial coverage' in the catalog, the layer panel and the legend, and the note travels with screenings (even those that find nothing), buffer lists, downloads and prints, so an empty result is not read as an absence.

note.description: What is covered, in one sentence.

buffer_presets.description: Buffer sources only (D-085): one-click buffers a rule defines, such as a riparian zone. Choosing one sets the distances in feet, dissolves, names the buffer and carries the note into its legend, download and print. Changing its distances drops the preset.

label.description: The button and the buffer's name, e.g. 'Riparian zone, 300 ft'.

note.description: The rule and what the buffer does not capture.

export_notes.description: Lines that travel with this layer's data (D-041, D-073). on: list (buffer result lists), export (data downloads), print (PDF and PNG). Mandatory wording, such as the parcel line, changes only with the owner's approval.

known_answers.description: Live and hybrid layers only: counts the nightly health check runs against the source. where uses source field names.

place_tags.description: Copy layers only. Which place columns the build adds (OPERATING_GUIDE.md §6.2). Every data layer uses all: county, county_fips, municipality, mun_code, tract, tract_geoid, block_group and bg_geoid, from the item's representative point. The boundary layers use the mode listed for them in pipeline/levels.py: none (state, counties), county (municipalities), county_overlap (census tracts), county_overlap_tract (block groups). all_by_district is for data layers whose source names each item's municipality (parcels, D-026): county and municipality come from the layer's own district_code field, tract and block group from the point.

tiles.description: Copy and hybrid layers only: the zoom range written into the PMTiles file, which is also where the layer draws. Dense layers use a higher min_zoom.

max_dropped_share.description: Hybrid layers: the reviewed share of shapes the map copy may drop as zero-area slivers (D-065). Without it, 5%.

partition.description: Parked (D-031); copy layers only. Large layers (M7, D-025): the build writes one set of files per municipality, and the viewer loads only the chosen municipality's files. `field` is the source field holding the 4-digit municipal code and must also be the source of the layer's district_code field. `host` r2 keeps the files off GitHub Pages (catalog/hosting.json). `selftest` names the municipality whose files the self-test cases use.

examples.description: One-click example filters shown to users. The build also turns them into self-test cases with expected counts. Data layers need at least one (LAYER_PLAYBOOK.md); the state outline has none.

label.description: Plain-language description, e.g. 'Towns with more than 50,000 people'.

allOf.description: copy: built with place tags and map tiles; sliced by its tags.
hybrid: map tiles only, no place tags; sliced and queried live.
area_codes goes with area_mode code, and only with it.
list_fields goes with buffer targets, and only with them.

style.description: One style preset (IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md §4.3). single: one color. categories: a color per displayed value of a field. graduated: 3 to 7 classes of a number field. Any kind may add labels.

label.description: Preset name in the Style panel, e.g. 'By property class'.

color.description: single: the fill, line or point color.

fill.description: single, polygons: false draws the outline only. Default true.

outline.description: Polygon edge or point ring color.

width.description: Line or outline width in pixels.

field.description: categories and graduated: the output field styled.

colors.description: categories: a color per displayed value (after transforms and value_labels).

widths.description: categories, lines: a width in pixels per displayed value.

palette.description: A fixed palette defined in site/js/studio/style.js. okabe_ito, anderson_level1 and flood are for categories; blues, greens, oranges, purples and reds for graduated.

other.description: categories: the color of values not listed. Default #BDBDBD.

breaks.description: graduated: fixed class breaks, ascending, one fewer than classes.

place.description: Place slice. county_fips is 3 digits (e.g. '033'); mun_code is the 4-digit NJ municipal code (e.g. '1709'); tract_geoid is the 11-digit census tract code and bg_geoid the 12-digit block group code.

condition.description: One filter condition. The same shape is used in recipes, in the viewer, in share links and in tests.
